s = input()
replaced = [False] * len(s)

# Convert string to list for mutability
s_list = list(s)

# Search for "at" starting from index 1 to len(s)-2
for i in range(1, len(s) - 1):
    if s[i:i+2] == "at":
        s_list[i] = '@'
        replaced[i + 1] = True
        break

# Search for "dot" starting from index 1 to len(s)-3
for i in range(1, len(s) - 2):
    if s[i:i+3] == "dot":
        s_list[i] = '.'
        replaced[i + 1] = True
        replaced[i + 2] = True

# Print characters that are not replaced
for i in range(len(s)):
    if not replaced[i]:
        print(s_list[i], end='')
